card.name: Accent-stripped Spanish and foreign word endings
card.fires_on: Partway or at the end of non-English words, mainly Spanish label phrases written without accents such as 'medica', 'prescripcion', 'segun'. Also fires on some French, Greek and Vietnamese name pieces.

modes.label: Spanish label wording
modes.description: Pieces of accent-less Spanish phrases on homeopathic product labels, such as 'prescripcion medica' and 'segun indicacion medica'.
modes.example: Aplique directamente bajo la lengua segun indicacion med<<ica>>.

modes.label: Other foreign words
modes.description: Ends or pieces of French, Greek or Vietnamese words and names in scholarly or list text.

card.plain: It lights up on Spanish label phrases written without accents, and on odd foreign word pieces elsewhere.
